## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Belongs with ORM core** — Tightly coupled to odoo.models.Model._where_calc() and search operations
- **Boundary code** — expression class consumes domains and emits SQL; utilities handle internal domain manipulation
- **Critical optimization point** — domain_combine_anies() reduces redundant any/not any nodes; impacts search scalability
- **Operator semantics** — Two-level syntax (domain operators + term operators) is non-uniform by design to prevent recursive embedding
- **Field type dispatch** — Large if/elif structure in parse() per field type; any new field type requires parse() extension
- **Relational field handling** — Many2one, one2many, many2many each have distinct SQL patterns (JOINs vs. subqueries vs. EXISTS)
- **No recursion** — Uses explicit stack + state machine to avoid Python recursion limits
- **Trigram indexing** — Supports PostgreSQL trigram-based prefiltering on translatable fields for performance
